The numbers-parser-*.numbers fixtures are unmodified copies of files from
numbers-parser (https://github.com/masaccio/numbers-parser), commit
5ec3694082e7003c824bb400eed97bd7e2eb9cd6:

  numbers-parser-test-3.numbers        tests/data/test-3.numbers
  numbers-parser-test-6.numbers        tests/data/test-6.numbers
  numbers-parser-test-bullets.numbers  tests/data/test-bullets.numbers
  numbers-parser-test-hlinks.numbers   tests/data/test-hlinks.numbers

Their expected contents are defined in that project's tests/test_large.py
(test-3, test-6) and tests/test_bullets.py (test-bullets, test-hlinks).

sha256:

a17f3831c75adc6570c0c63fae06fa4e5a1728b72d31a90c8612b6ad7e20d69a  numbers-parser-test-6.numbers
b6c04428b4c85de1f41c84a6648d4885f1e525a5a74bea8af89cc97a9063b408  numbers-parser-test-bullets.numbers
c8b5262e3543225b8f09254f7a8d064703de96bed7efd733f4d99d2e9a70490b  numbers-parser-test-hlinks.numbers
